concept: Auto Scaling: self-healing via health checks and desired capacity
tests: How to automatically replace EC2 instances that fail health checks and keep the required number of healthy instances.
expected: EC2 Auto Scaling group with health checks (EC2/ELB) and desired capacity — replaces unhealthy instances automatically. Triggers: "automatically replace instances that fail health checks", "maintain desired number".
why_not: A load balancer only routes traffic and doesn't replace instances; termination protection blocks replacement; one large instance — no redundancy.
